meta.title: Morteza Poudat – Python & Web Developer
meta.description: Python & web developer in Germany: fast websites, data extraction and automation for small businesses and engineering companies.

hero.sub: I build fast websites, data tools and automations for small businesses and engineering companies.

items.d: Modern, mobile-friendly websites that load fast, are easy to find on Google and come in German and English.
I get data out of PDFs (including scanned files with OCR and table detection), spreadsheets and websites, clean it and load it into structured databases. I also design data models that fit your data.
Plugins and extensions for business data software, internal tools (e.g. time tracking with Clockify integration), Python APIs and automations, with advice from requirements to rollout.

nilughorbani.d: Portfolio website for Nilu Ghorbani, an artist based in Düsseldorf with a background in architecture. It presents her paintings, mixed-media works and studio projects, in English and German. Built by me.

profis-barbershop.d: Mobile-first online booking for a one-person barbershop in Düsseldorf. A client prototype from 2026: concept, UX design and full-stack development by me.
long: Customers choose a service, swipe through a day carousel that shows free times at a glance and reserve their appointment in a few taps. There is no payment, so it feels like booking an appointment, not buying something. They receive a confirmation email with a calendar file and a cancel link, followed by reminders.

The owner works in a secure admin area with password and authenticator-code login. There they set opening hours, the lunch break and blocked times, and see their appointments in day, week and month views, along with customers and services.

Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM and next-intl for German and English. A database constraint rules out double bookings, and Playwright end-to-end tests cover the booking flow.

portfolio.d: A bilingual, fast and accessible portfolio built with Next.js and Tailwind.

business-demo.d: A complete example website for a local business, with menu/services, opening hours, map and contact form.

materials-data.d: Imports public/sample material data from files, cleans it, stores it in a database and lets you search and filter it in the browser.

pdf-extractor.d: Upload a PDF datasheet, even a scanned one. The tool finds the tables with OCR and grid detection, turns them into clean rows and saves them in a database you can search.

about.title: About
about.text: I'm a Python and web developer based in Germany, working on data software for the materials and engineering industry. I build pipelines that extract data from PDFs (including OCR and table/grid detection), spreadsheets and the web, then clean it and load it into structured technical databases. I design data models that link materials with their tests, specimens and measurement data such as spectra. I also develop plugins for enterprise data software and internal tools such as time tracking. Beyond code, I give technical presentations, advise clients, gather requirements and manage software rollout projects. As a freelancer I help small businesses get online and help engineering teams turn messy data into reliable tools.
